style: Flat editorial illustration for a modern running app. Geometric shapes, soft paper grain, gentle depth, confident composition. Limited palette only: a burnt orange (the brand color, used for the main accent), a deep cobalt blue (secondary), a warm off-white background, a soft light gray, and a near-black ink for small details. Friendly and optimistic, never cartoonish. Absolutely no text of any kind: no words, letters, numbers, color codes, signs, labels, logos or watermarks. Subject centered with generous empty margins so the image can sit behind or beside interface elements. Never draw real brands or trademarks (no swoosh, three stripes or similar marks).

assets.name: app-icon-orange
assets.use: The app icon (iPhone and Watch ship variant 1, center-cropped to 900 px so the orange reaches the corners, then resized to 1024). Use --reference Design/Images/app-icon-concept.png to keep the mark.
assets.prompt: An iOS app icon. A solid burnt orange background fills the entire square edge to edge, reaching all four corners: no rounded corners, no border, no frame, no outer shadow, no white or dark margin. Centered on it, one bold, simple mark in warm off-white: a stylized runner mid-stride bursting through a tilted oval running-track ring, with a thin deep cobalt blue offset shadow for depth. Flat vector look with a very subtle paper grain, crisp edges, and generous space around the mark so it reads at small sizes. No text, letters, numbers or logos.
